citation.description: The census test `test_no_timeout_marker_is_tighter_than_the_autouse_git_probe_bound` walks every `tests/**/*.py` and flags any literal marker below the bound. The bound is `2 * GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS`, with both constants imported from `_isolation`. `tests/_isolation.py:29` sets GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS = 3, so the floor is 30 s. A search for `mark.timeout(` under `tests/` shows the smallest real marker is 30 (test_review_bot.py:1768, 1800, 1831, 1880; test_timeout_budget.py:274; test_opcert_service_app.py). The other real markers are 60, 120, 180 and 900. The sub-30 values (4, 2.5, 9) appear only inside string literals in the census self-test, so the AST walk does not see them.

criteria.criterion: No literal `pytest.mark.timeout(N)` under `tests/` is below the autouse git-probe bound, enforced by a census test in `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` that derives its floor from `tests/_isolation.py`.
